description.html: Arcadia EarthPro-Ca is a pure calcium supplement without vitamin D3 from the Arcadia EarthPro line. It is designed for daily use in reptiles that have adequate UVB lighting in the terrarium - animals synthesize vitamin D3 on their own under UVB light, so they do not need extra D3 in a supplement. Dust it over food before every feeding to ensure optimal calcium intake.

Pure calcium without D3 is safer for daily use because it eliminates the risk of a vitamin D3 overdose, which can lead to organ calcification. It is part of the Arcadia EarthPro protocol, in which EarthPro-Ca is used daily and the EarthPro-A vitamin supplement once a week.
